meta.construction: order-2 group swapping the two structurally identical wait states 1 (wait-fin) and 2 (closing)
meta.why_it_looks_legal: the two states have the same shape: one outgoing edge into the goal, otherwise only penalized self-loops -- on the unlabeled graph the swap maps arrows to arrows
meta.why_it_is_not_a_symmetry: the completion events differ: state 1 waits for rcv FIN, state 2 waits for rcv ACK of FIN. With event names pinned the swap reads 'the peer's FIN arrived' as 'the peer acknowledged' -- a protocol error (TV 1.0 on the completion edges)
